info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v2-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loan Payoffs API provides users with the capability to retrieve a comprehensive list of mortgage loan payoffs. This endpoint allows consumers, such as financial institutions and mortgage servicers, to access detailed information on outstanding loan payoffs for better financial assessment and reporting. By utilizing this API, developers can integrate payoff data into their applications, enabling efficient tracking and management of loan statuses. Ideal for applications focusing on mortgage analytics and management, this API streamlines the process of accessing critical loan information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payoff amount for a specified loan. It provides essential details needed for making informed financial decisions regarding loan repayment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the necessary parameters for obtaining loan payoff information. The user should provide relevant loan identifiers to retrieve the appropriate payoff details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the payoff information for the loan.

ListMortgageLoansPayoffsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on loan payoff, expressed as a string. It is expected to provide a valid JSON string when passed in a request.
